component.name: OpenDeviceHub
component.summary: Configure Keychron keyboards: keys, lighting and settings

description.p: Configure Keychron keyboards that run Keychron's open source ZMK firmware, without a browser or a background service. OpenDeviceHub talks to the keyboard directly, like Keychron Launcher does.

ul.li: Keychron V3 Ultra 8K (ANSI, ISO, JIS) over USB or the Ultra-Link 8K 2.4 GHz receiver
Remap every key and the knob on each layer: keys with modifiers, media and mouse keys, layers, lighting and Keychron keys
Lighting effect, brightness, speed and colour
Polling rate (USB and 2.4 GHz), debounce and the idle and sleep timers

description.p: Needs a udev rule for /dev/hidraw access; see the project page.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Keychron.
